# opnsense_interfaces_vxlan (Resource)

Manages an OPNsense VXLAN interface in unicast or multicast mode.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_address` (String) Local source IPv4 or IPv6 address used for encapsulation.
- `vni` (Number) VXLAN Network Identifier.

### Optional

- `multicast_group` (String) Multicast group for multicast mode. Mutually exclusive with remote_address.
- `multicast_interface` (String) Physical interface used to transmit multicast packets. Required with multicast_group and forbidden with remote_address.
- `remote_address` (String) Remote tunnel endpoint for unicast mode. Mutually exclusive with multicast_group.
- `remote_port` (Number) Remote UDP destination port.
- `source_port` (Number) Local UDP source port.

### Read-Only

- `device_id` (Number) Automatically allocated VXLAN device number.
- `id` (String) UUID of the VXLAN configuration.
